name: Rename active view
request: Make a reusable tool that renames the active view to the name I supply.
description: Renames the captured active view. Revit rejects invalid or duplicate names. One native Undo restores the prior name.
source: var before = doc.ActiveView.Name; doc.ActiveView.Name = inputs.GetProperty("name").GetString(); return new { viewId = doc.ActiveView.Id.Value, before, after = doc.ActiveView.Name };
expectedResult: The exact active view has the requested name and the returned before/after values match native readback.

tests.name: name-readback
tests.assumptions: A disposable nonworkshared project with an editable active project view; the test name is unused. Restore its original name after the test.
tests.expectedResult: Native active view name equals the requested name after execution.
